goal: A session's `.json` and `runs.tsv` row carry what the session actually cost: `sessionResult` takes the running totals from the last `result` line and adds only the per-turn-group amounts.

The plan-writing instruction tells every plan session and the brief to name `runner.model` on each step, preferring narrow, checkable Haiku steps at `effort: high`, and `docs/project/README.md` no longer offers `advisor` or `subagents`.
contract: `plan-schema.js`, `sessionSettings`, `headlessArgs`, `STEP_WORKER_AGENTS`, `canon/roles/_step-workers.md` and `withWorkers` are unchanged: plans on `main` with `advisor` or `subagents: on` still validate and run.
`SESSION_DEFAULTS` is unchanged: a step that names no model still runs on `opus` at `medium`.
out_of_scope: Removing `advisor` and `subagents` from the schema or the code — a later clean-up once no plan on `main` uses them.
Re-planning steps already on `main` in other projects.
Rewriting old `.json` files or `runs.tsv` rows under `~/mc/runner/log/`.
`docs/technical/mc-run.md` § *The session*'s description of `advisor` and `subagents`, which still describes code that stays.

success_criteria.criterion: `sessionResult` over a stream with several `result` lines gives the last line's cost: step 11 of week-focus-rows reads 2.09 USD, not 6.44.
success_criteria.check: `node --input-type=module -e "import {sessionResult} from './src/mc/run-plan.js'; import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs'; console.log(sessionResult(readFileSync(process.env.HOME + '/mc/runner/log/week-focus-rows-20261013T075918Z.jsonl','utf8')).total_cost_usd.toFixed(2))"` in memoro-cli prints `2.09`.

success_criteria.criterion: `canon/roles/_plan-writing.md` asks for `runner.model` on every step with Haiku preferred, and `docs/project/README.md` names neither `advisor` nor `subagents`.

steps.title: `sessionResult` takes the running totals from the last result line
steps.done_when: The success-criterion-0 command prints `2.09`, `node --test --import ./tests/_isolate-home.mjs tests/mc/run-plan.test.js` passes, and `mc gate` is green.
instruction: Why: claude now prints `total_cost_usd`, `duration_api_ms` and `modelUsage` on each `result` line as running totals for the session, while `num_turns`, `duration_ms` and `usage` stay per turn group. Measured 2026-10-13 over all 45 streams in `~/mc/runner/log/` with more than one result line: cost never decreased from one line to the next. `week-focus-rows-20261013T075918Z.jsonl` has five result lines with `total_cost_usd` 0.63, 0.90, 1.10, 1.72, 2.09 and `num_turns` 21, 1, 6, 4, 10; its `.json` says 6.44 because `sessionResult` adds the costs.

Code, in `src/mc/run-plan.js`. Change `RESULT_SUMS` (line ~1120) to `['num_turns', 'duration_ms']`. `total_cost_usd` and `duration_api_ms` then come from `const out = { ...last }` as they are. Delete the block that builds `models` from every result's `modelUsage` (the `const models = {}` loop and the `if (results.some((r) => r.modelUsage)) out.modelUsage = models;` line), so `modelUsage` is the last line's. Delete `MODEL_USAGE_KEPT` and its comment: nothing else uses it (`grep -rn MODEL_USAGE_KEPT src tests` finds only those lines). Keep the `usage` summing over `USAGE_SUMS` exactly as it is.

Rewrite the doc comment above `sessionResult` to say: the last `result` line of a stream-json run, with the per-turn-group amounts of every result line added up. One process can print more than one (a check-in written as the session finished starts a new turn with its own `result`, step-cost step 3, 2026-09-11). `num_turns`, `duration_ms` and the four `usage` counts are that turn group's and are summed; `total_cost_usd`, `duration_api_ms` and `modelUsage` are running totals for the session (measured 2026-10-13, ruling 42) and are the last line's, as are `subtype`, `is_error`, `result` and `session_id`. Keep the paragraph about `--output-format json`.

Test, in `tests/mc/run-plan.test.js`: replace the test `'adds two results up, and takes the rest from the last'` (line ~645) with `'adds the turn group amounts, and takes the running totals from the last'`. Both results get `session_id: 'sid'`. First: `num_turns: 30, total_cost_usd: 1.5, duration_ms: 1000, duration_api_ms: 800, modelUsage: { sonnet: { inputTokens: 5, outputTokens: 7, contextWindow: 200000 } }`. Second: `num_turns: 2, total_cost_usd: 1.75, duration_ms: 200, duration_api_ms: 900, subtype: 'error_during_execution', is_error: true, result: 'blocked', usage: { input_tokens: 1, output_tokens: 2, cache_read_input_tokens: 3, cache_creation_input_tokens: 4 }, modelUsage: { sonnet: { inputTokens: 6, outputTokens: 8, contextWindow: 200000 }, opus: { inputTokens: 9, outputTokens: 9 } }`. Assert `num_turns` 32, `total_cost_usd` 1.75, `duration_ms` 1200, `duration_api_ms` 900, the same summed `usage` as today, `modelUsage` deep-equal to the second's, `session_id` 'sid', `subtype` and `result` the second's, and the `readSessionOutput` row as today with `session: 'sid'`. The `result()` helper's default usage is what the current test already sums; keep using it.

Docs, in `docs/technical/mc-run.md`. In the paragraph that ends 'and `sessionResult` adds their turns, cost, durations and usage up rather than taking the last.' replace that clause with 'and `sessionResult` adds up their turns, wall-clock and usage, which are per turn group, and takes cost, API time and `modelUsage` from the last, which claude prints as running totals (ruling 42; until 2026-10-13 it added the costs too, so an older `.json` with two results overstates its cost)'. In the two places that say '(summed when there were two' — the `runs.tsv` bullet and the `log/<name>-<ts>.jsonl` bullet — write '(turns and usage summed when there were two' instead, keeping the rest of each sentence.
Run the success-criterion-0 command from the memoro-cli workarea root and paste its output into the PR body.

steps.title: The plan-writing instruction asks for a model on every step, Haiku first; README drops `advisor` and `subagents`
steps.done_when: Both success-criterion-1 greps give the stated result, `node --test --import ./tests/_isolate-home.mjs tests/mc/canon.test.js tests/mc/roles.test.js` passes, and `mc gate` is green.
instruction: In `canon/roles/_plan-writing.md`, insert this bullet directly after the bullet that begins '- **Each step:**' (and before '- **Overall:**'), exactly:

- **Model per step (ruling 42):** every step names `runner.model`. Haiku is
  the first choice: `{ "model": "haiku", "effort": "high" }` for a step
  whose `instruction` says exactly what changes, where and in what order,
  and whose `done_when` passes or fails on its own — a test, a grep, an
  unchanged digest. `opus` only for a step that needs design or judgement no
  instruction can settle beforehand, and only once you have tried to split
  it: decide here, and let Haiku steps carry it out. Many narrow Haiku steps
  beat one broad Opus step.

In `docs/project/README.md`, the plan-level `runner` bullet (line ~40, beginning '- `runner` — optional: `tool`, `model`, `effort`, `advisor`, `subagents`,'): replace the whole bullet, up to and including the line ending '§ *The session*).', with:

- `runner` — optional: `tool`, `model`, `effort`, `check_in_minutes`,
  `stall_minutes`.
  Only what the runner actually reads; there is no field here that nothing
  enforces. `effort` is one of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`. What a
  key leaves unsaid is the runner's default for the session's kind — a step
  runs on `opus` at `medium`, and a plan session (`mc plan`) on `opus`
  (ruling 18, [`docs/technical/mc-run.md`](../technical/mc-run.md)
  § *The session*). Each step names its own model (below, ruling 42).

In the same file, the step-level `runner` bullet (line ~84, beginning '- `runner` — optional: `model`, `effort`, `advisor`, `subagents`, for a step that needs'): replace its first two lines, up to 'something other than the plan's.', with:

- `runner` — `model` and `effort`. Every step names its `model`: `haiku` at
  `high` effort for a narrow step with a checkable `done_when`, `opus` for one
  that needs judgement (ruling 42, `canon/roles/_plan-writing.md`). Each key
  overrides the plan's `runner` on its own.

Then delete the sentence that follows, 'Each key overrides the plan's `runner` on its own, and a step that names only its effort keeps the plan's model.', since the new text carries it; keep the rest of the bullet ('`tool`, `check_in_minutes` and `stall_minutes` are the plan's alone…' onward) unchanged. After the edits, `grep -n -E 'advisor|subagents' docs/project/README.md` must find nothing; if it finds another line, remove only the words naming `advisor` or `subagents` from it and say so in the PR body.

Do not touch `canon/roles/_step-workers.md`, `src/`, or `docs/technical/mc-run.md`. If `tests/mc/canon.test.js` or `tests/mc/roles.test.js` pins a digest or the text of `_plan-writing.md`, update the pin to the new text and name it in the PR body.
